items.title: Launch of a Cooperation Project for Women’s and Girls’ Leadership in Senegal
items.description: (ANSA) - IL CAIRO, 24 LUG - The Italian Ambassador to Senegal, Michele Tommasi, spoke at the first meeting of the National Steering Committee for the Parel/F project—an initiative funded by Italian Cooperation to strengthen the leadership and socioeconomic inclusion of women and girls in Senegal—to reaffirm Italy’s support for this initiative. items.title: Africa: AU, U.S. Envoy Discuss Aussom's Future Amid Funding Uncertainty

items.title: Ambassador to Senegal Opens Goreé School for Sustainable Migration
items.description: (ANSA) - IL CAIRO, 21 LUG - Italian Ambassador to Senegal Michele Tommasi attended the opening ceremony of the Gorée School 2026, organized as part of the project “Training, Dignity, Inclusion, and Innovation in Senegal,” funded by Italian Cooperation. Organized by the Institute for the Rights of Migrant Workers, in partnership with Inca Cgil Senegal, VIS, and numerous Italian and Senegalese institutional and social actors, the Gorée School serves as a unique forum for dialogue and exchange. items.title: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab
items.description: The Somali government’s battle with Al-Shabaab militants grinds on, with neither able to gain a decisive advantage. To improve its lot, Mogadishu needs to bolster its military and alleviate civilian suffering in areas under insurgent control, while looking for openings for dialogue with the group.
items.titleIt: New Chapter, Same Stalemate: Somalia’s War with Al-Shabaab

items.title: “Strategic Balance” under Stress: Egypt and the U.S.-Israeli War with Iran
items.description: Egypt has been walking a tightrope since the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran began, joining mediation efforts while signalling solidarity with Gulf Arab partners under Iranian attack. But with some Gulf capitals voicing expectations of stronger support, Cairo may find itself under increasing pressure.
items.titleIt: “Strategic Balance” under Stress: Egypt and the U.S.-Israeli War with Iran

items.title: No rush to find new Italy coach says Maldini
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, JUL 23 - The Italian Soccer Federation's (FIGC) new Technical Director Paolo Maldini said Thursday that he was not in a rush to appoint a new coach for the national team. items.title: Italy to use escape clause for energy investments says Meloni
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, JUL 21 - Premier Giorgia Meloni said Tuesday that Italy will use the escape clause created by the European Commission after Italy called for the flexibility in the Stability and Growth Pact for defence spending to be extended to energy investments in the wake of the price spikes triggered by the Iran war. Her office said that the decision was made during a meeting with the leaders of the other parties supporting her ruling coalition. items.titleIt: Italy to use escape clause for energy investments says Meloni

items.title: Woman, 55, dies two months after being hit in Modena car attack
items.description: (ANSA) - ROME, JUL 22 - A 55-year-old woman who was among the people hit by a car attack in the northern city of Modena on May 16 has died, the hospital she was being treated at said on Wednesday. Monica Esposito never regained consciousness after the attack by a 31-year-old Italian citizen of Moroccan origin with mental-health problems, Salim El Koudri. items.title: Sudan: 80 Sudanese Leave Uganda On Voluntary Return Flight
items.description: [Dabanga] Amsterdam / Kampala -- The 11th voluntary return flight carrying Sudanese refugees from Uganda to Sudan departed on Thursday with 80 returnees on board. The flight travelled to Port Sudan Airport aboard a Tarco Aviation aircraft and was sponsored by Sudan's General Intelligence Service.
items.titleIt: Sudan: 80 Sudanese Leave Uganda On Voluntary Return Flight
